findings.failure_path: An inherited server with an auto-approved send, write or delete tool now remains available during inference. If candidate content induces the reviewer to invoke it, the operation can complete before audit_codex returns tool_boundary_violation. The read-only filesystem sandbox cannot prevent remote MCP side effects, and rejecting the verdict cannot undo them. This violates the unchanged capability requirement.
findings.smallest_fix: Enforce packet-only tool availability and invocation before execution, including plugin-provided tools, while preserving selected skill loading. Keep the event audit as an additional check.

findings.failure_path: The approval test uses pass, and plugin_mcp also emits a canned verdict. A CLI that accepts the configuration but still refuses read_packet can pass every new assertion. The frozen packet contains no inspectable real-CLI trace establishing the claimed repair and omits the relevant negative preflight fixtures, leaving required runtime and failure-path acceptance unverified.
findings.smallest_fix: Supply a verifiable completed read_packet trace under the exact required settings with plugin inheritance, include the negative preflight fixtures, and extend the regression to combine plugin inheritance with the existing packet_read behavior.

skipped_clients.reason: claude belongs to the implementer model family

concern_results.conclusion: Packet selection and transport binding remain restrictive. Successful packet reads under the required settings are not demonstrated by the supplied execution evidence.
Leaving inherited servers enabled permits side effects before the audit rejects their calls.
Visible checks reject absent, duplicate, disabled and mis-bound packet rows. Relevant negative fixtures are missing from the packet.
New assertions verify emitted configuration and synthetic verdicts. The extraction register's RED/GREEN and real-CLI claims lack inspectable execution artifacts.
No public flag, exit-code or result-schema changes are visible. Package version fields consistently advance to 0.15.5.
No data migration appears. Reverting the code cannot reverse side effects performed through inherited tools.
Preflight reason codes remain unchanged. The supplied audit identifies foreign calls, but approval failures still lack the underlying tool-error detail.
Post-execution auditing does not enforce packet-only capabilities. The candidate's accepted-residual statements do not satisfy the frozen requirement against capability expansion.
